question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Delay in doing something to a later time
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'Procrastination'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the group of words "Delay in doing something to a later time" is** "Procrastination."**
 
• **Procrastination: **Procrastination refers to the act of intentionally delaying or postponing tasks or actions.(स्थगित)
 
• It captures the meaning of delaying something to a later time, making it the most appropriate option in this context.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Procrastination'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Explanation of the** other options:**

 
• **Span:** Span refers to the length of time or duration that something covers or extends over.(अवधि)
 
• **Schedule: **Schedule refers to a plan or timetable that outlines the order or timing of events or activities.(अनुसूची) 
 
• **Ephemeral: **Ephemeral means something that is short-lived or lasts for a brief period of time.(क्षणिक)
